query: select h.event_id,h.session_id,h.outcome,h.evidence_class,h.received_at from (select event_id,session_id,outcome,evidence_class,received_at from procedure_outcome_headers where tenant_id=$1 and context_run_id=$2 order by received_at desc,event_id limit 33) h join session_events e on e.tenant_id=$1 and e.id=h.event_id order by h.received_at desc,h.event_id
